_cycle_finding: The 'three arb pools' do NOT form one clean 3-hop cycle. The CORE closed loop is the 2-hop CFG spread: pool[0] WETH/CFG v3 (buy CFG) -> pool[1] native-ETH/CFG v4 (sell CFG for ETH), ETH~=WETH — the native-ETH-vs-WETH CFG spread family (CLAUDE.md §6b / 0xa32b). pool[2] is native-ETH/0x6440f144 (a DIFFERENT token, not CFG) — a separate leg in the same tx, NOT part of the CFG loop. The A0 replay should reconstruct the CFG 2-hop loop; treat pool[2] as out-of-cycle unless a fuller trace shows otherwise.
_correction_20260704_fable: ^^^ ABOVE _cycle_finding is WRONG (contradicted by the receipt in analysis/src/test/fixtures/coffee-20260704/tx-2.json — verified pure-local, zero node). (1) The CFG 2-hop is a LOSING leg, not the edge: from the persisted pre-states it is fee-negative in BOTH directions (~-1e-4 ETH at 0.01 ETH in, worsening with size) because the tick spread is only 0.323% while round-trip fee is ~1.3% (v3 fee 3000=0.3% + v4 lpFee 10001~1.0%); and in the REAL execution the CFG leg netted -0.00000226 ETH (spent 0.00023058 ETH buying 2.00354 CFG on v4 ETH/CFG, sold it for 0.00022833 WETH on v3 WETH/CFG). (2) pool[2] native-ETH/BOLD is INTEGRAL, not out-of-cycle. The true atomic cycle: Balancer flash 0.0001818 WETH -> unwrap ETH -> Liquity V2 BOLD issuance 0.40749 BOLD (mint events at 0x9502b7c/0x8869a6fb/0x807def5e) -> v4 BOLD->ETH->CFG -> v3 CFG->WETH -> repay Balancer, keep +0.0000465 WETH (~$0.17, matches netUsdReported). The EDGE is the Liquity BOLD-issuance price vs DEX price, NOT any pool-cycle DEX spread. CONSEQUENCE for BS-0: the specified gate (reconstruct CFG 2-hop from these two pool states + assert expectedGrossWei>0) is UNACHIEVABLE and would validate a false claim; and this tx is a POOR exemplar for 'scanner-contestable pure-DEX loop' because its edge needs Liquity-issuance + Balancer-flash modeling (not a token-graph pool edge). expectedGrossWei stays null (harness not written). Resolution is an operator decision needing a node re-read: (a) re-select a genuine pure-DEX 2-3 hop exemplar from coffee's set, or (b) redefine BS-0's substantiation.
